data.title: Seven jobs, seven [[free]] tools
data.subtitle: One free AI tool per job, and the limit to watch on each.

cards.title: ChatGPT Free
cards.text: Unlimited text chats with GPT-6, within abuse guardrails.

cards.title: Claude Free
cards.text: Word, PDF and PowerPoint files, plus Docs and Slides. No ads.

cards.title: Gamma Free
cards.text: A deck from one prompt, up to 10 slides at a time.

cards.title: Gemini
cards.text: Nano Banana 2 makes and edits images at 2K, free.

cards.title: Otter Basic
cards.text: 300 minutes a month, live, with Zoom, Teams and Meet.

cards.title: Copilot Free
cards.text: Code suggestions and chat in your editor.
